name: Mountaincart-Abfahrt Brixen im Thale
beschreibung:
=== description ===
With the Mountaincart, you’ll descend the access road of the Brixental mountain railways at a thrilling pace. These specially designed tricycles are easy to steer, making the unique speed rush an unforgettable experience. Children aged 8 and up can ride in a tandem seat with an adult.
